_comment: Plugin registry (batch 1). Add a plugin = add one entry here; no code change. `dir` is relative to the program directory (absolute allowed). `deps` are Python import names checked with importlib.util.find_spec. Enable/disable state lives in settings.ini [plugins] keyed by the raw id; absent = enabled_by_default.

plugins.description: 6-step distilled LoRA acceleration for the maskless image-EDIT path (batch 3 sampling_plan capability; off by default).
公共 LoRA 管理器：扫描 <comfy_root>/models/loras，与 loras.json 比对，未被 owner=model/Plugin 记录的归公共（默认关）；只读日志，不写回。
